topic: Someone finds their college application essay published as an example
text: Finding out that your personal essay was published as an example can feel like a mix of surprise and exposure. I remember when I first learned about it; I was sitting in a cozy corner of the library, the same place where I had drafted my essay. It’s a strange feeling to know that something so personal, something you poured your heart into, is now out there for others to learn from. I took a deep breath, reminded myself of why I wrote it, and felt proud. It’s a reminder that our words can touch more lives than we initially imagine. If you’re feeling a bit vulnerable or exposed, just know that this is a moment to celebrate your voice and your story. Let’s take this as a step forward and embrace the impact you’re making, no matter how small it might seem.
